      properties:
        title:
          title: Title

          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and, on read,
            holds the composed address: when structured fields are supplied it is the normalized
            addressLine1 with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present;
            otherwise the normalized flat input.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized and, when
            present, appended to addressLine1 to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"

          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.NotDisposableEmail"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's

          format: date

    Owner:

              type: string

            telephoneDisplay:

              description: The canonical region encoded in the leading '<REGION>' segment of the customerCode (derived from the postcode's fixed range NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Stable code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the region derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household id
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners in the same household (same last name and postcode), derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and the postcode. Assigned whenever the owner has a postcode, so members share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '0a1b2c3d4e5f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal year ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Stable code formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the fiscalYear.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds 1 fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived on read as 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate, one of 'MINOR'

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.

              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-0A1B2C3D4E5F'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at creation time, shared an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:

              format: int32

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

The spec required `GET /api/owners/{id}` (and the create response) to return `selfLink = "/api/owners/" + id`. The `OwnerDto` is generated at build time from the OpenAPI spec, and derived fields are populated by the MapStruct `OwnerMapper` — matching the existing pattern for `displayName`, `salutation`, `identityKey`, etc.

Two changes, each in the place that owns that concern:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `selfLink` (read-only string) property to the `Owner` schema, alongside `id`, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added `@Mapping(target = "selfLink", expression = "java(formatSelfLink(owner))")` on `toOwnerDto`, plus a small single-responsibility `formatSelfLink(owner)` default method that returns `"/api/owners/" + owner.getId()`.

This reuses the established derived-field mechanism rather than hand-building the link in the controller, so it's populated consistently everywhere an owner is serialized (get, list, create, page).

The full test suite (including the new `AcceptanceTest.coreReturnsSelfLink`) is green: `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
